{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check how many of the invalid revenue rows are in the 'completed' status
invalid_revenue_rows = sales[sales['revenue'].isna()]
invalid_revenue_completed_count = invalid_revenue_rows[invalid_revenue_rows['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Also check total completed orders for context
total_completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Print the results
invalid_revenue_completed_count, total_completed"}
